issues.evidence: Bud, mother, neck and nuclear-envelope leader anchors contain text-placement offsets. At p=.15 the bud leader is 1.286 scene units beyond actual bud bounds; the envelope label stays at [-1.1,.8,.6] while the nucleus changes shape and position.
issues.whyWrong: Native and exported leader lines use label.position as the model target, not as a text layout suggestion. Offsets can identify empty space or a different structure; named chemical labels must follow the drawn chemical state.
issues.repairPlan: Bind cell/envelope leaders to actual surface vertices, and track the bud and mother/neck through growth/separation.

At p=.72 the ethanol label is active while reduction=.550 and the encoded carbonyl double bond remains; glucose, pyruvate and CO2 visibility also uses unrelated coarse time thresholds.

issues.evidence: Replication/MI/MII, prospore membrane and mature spore labels point at static text offsets. At p=.72 the PSM leader is 1.171 units outside the selected growing membrane bounds; the static top caption also omits that a/alpha diploid is the starting state.
issues.whyWrong: Native and exported leader lines use label.position as the model target, not as a text layout suggestion. Offsets can identify empty space or a different structure; named chemical labels must follow the drawn chemical state.

issues.evidence: Default yeast/EN critical-final .799 shows one broad circular common NE; .801 replaces it with four small isolated nuclei over 0.002 progress (~72 ms of 36 s duration). Source pinch multiplies only z so x/y silhouette never divides. Original images and two source fixtures hashed in nuclear-handoff-baseline/manifest.json.
issues.whyWrong: The visible late-meiotic nuclear envelope must partition around the inherited nuclei; a broad undivided surface disappearing at a visibility threshold omits the represented membrane remodeling and creates an abrupt contour jump.
issues.repairPlan: Create a real continuous four-lobed constriction whose terminal surface matches daughter nuclear envelopes; retain correct closed meiotic nuclear envelope, inherited chromatids, real SPB/PSM surface attachment, nutrient controls and arbitrary seek. No static hiding or global fidelity reduction.
